pokedexEntries.sc: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

pokedexEntries.vi: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

pokedexEntries.za: Capsakid is prone to intense mood swings, perhaps influenced by the spicy chemicals inside it. It will bite anything it takes a disliking to.
